what: Divide the board into N×N cells (default 5×5, center cell left empty). Seven workers start at .2s intervals, each picks an empty cell and pushes a picture piece up from below in .8s (ease-out curve), holds it for 4s, then pushes it out upward in .8s (ease-in curve), moving on to the next cell without rest. Two never overlap in the same cell, and no-adjacent pieces are not placed in the cells on either side of the center. It runs only while visible

options.n: Cells per side, default 5 (3 recommended on phones) — the center cell is always left empty
options.workers: Number of workers running at once, default 7 (phone 4)
options.pause: Pause from finishing one slot to the next, in seconds, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Piece templates to put in cells (several) — hidden, then copied for use. data-side="off" Not placed in the cells beside the center of the plane

from.where: index.html .ix-hero__grid (Hero 5×5 cells — original Framer code part count 5 · cellsPerCycle 7 · slideDuration 800 · displayDuration 4000 · stagger 200, phone 3 · 4)

note: Cells and pieces are random each time it opens, so the same moment as the original can’t be compared. With reduced motion, each cell holds one piece still (skipping the center, starting from the first piece in order)
